historical.note: REIPPPP delivered ~3.6 GW wind and ~4 GW solar in about 15 years.

irp.note: Implied by IRP 2025: 34 GW wind and 25 GW solar by 2039.

masterplan.note: Renewable Energy Masterplan ambition of roughly 5 GW a year.

deliverable.note: Wind and gas at the Renewable Energy Masterplan’s pace; utility solar 2.5 GW and rooftop 2 GW a year, 4.5 GW together, above South Africa’s record of 2.6 GW a year and below Australia’s current rate on similar demand; storage 2 GW a year, about three times the 0.6–0.7 GW a year procured so far. A judgement about what is deliverable, not a published target.

grid.note: All remaining GCCA headroom (21.5 GW wind, 19.9 GW solar) spread to 2030. Zero headroom remains in the Northern Cape, Hydra Central, or for Western Cape solar.

eskomGreen.note: Eskom Green’s own plan: 32 GW renewables and storage by FY2040, gas to 3 GW by FY2031. The technology split is assumed – Eskom publishes a combined figure – and this is one builder, so treat it as a floor on the national build rather than a forecast of it.

none.note: No build limit – shows what pure economics would choose, which is not physically deliverable.
